name: Silken Tofu with Sesame Soy Sauce
author: simplyrecipes.com
steps: Prepare the tofu: Drain the tofu and gently remove it from its packaging onto a large plate. Carefully slice the tofu into 1/2-inch slabs widthwise. With the palm of your hands, gently push the sliced tofu sidewise so that they fan out over the plate.
Garnish with toppings and serve: Drizzle the soy sauce and sesame sauce on top. Then garnish it with scallions and sesame seeds, and serve.
Tightly cover leftovers and refrigerate for up to 2 days. You can enjoy it cold straight out of the fridge or you can reheat it by microwaving in 30-second increments until warmed through

culture.text: Soy sauce is a liquid condiment of Chinese origin, traditionally made from a fermented paste of soybeans, roasted grain, brine, and Aspergillus oryzae or Aspergillus sojae molds (kōji). It is recognized for its saltiness and pronounced umami taste.
